First, note that 49 weeks and 7 days = 49 weeks + 1 week = 50 weeks.  
50 weeks = 50 × 7 = 350 days.

1618 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1618 not divisible by 4).

From 1618-09-22 subtract 22 days → 1618-09-00? Better to do stepwise:  

350 days = 1 year less 15 days? Let's compute directly:  
Subtract 350 days from 1618-09-22:  

1618-09-22 minus 350 days:  
First subtract 22 days → 1618-08-31 (since Aug has 31 days).  
Remaining days: 350 - 22 = 328 days.  

Now subtract 328 days from 1618-08-31:  
Subtract 31 days of Aug → 1618-07-31. Remaining: 328 - 31 = 297.  
Subtract 31 days of July → 1618-06-30. Remaining: 297 - 31 = 266.  
Subtract 30 days of June → 1618-05-31. Remaining: 266 - 30 = 236.  
Subtract 31 days of May → 1618-04-30. Remaining: 236 - 31 = 205.  
Subtract 30 days of Apr → 1618-03-31. Remaining: 205 - 30 = 175.  
Subtract 31 days of Mar → 1618-02-28 (1618 not leap). Remaining: 175 - 31 = 144.  
Subtract 28 days of Feb → 1618-01-31. Remaining: 144 - 28 = 116.  
Subtract 31 days of Jan → 1617-12-31. Remaining: 116 - 31 = 85.  

Now subtract 85 days from 1617-12-31:  
Dec has 31 days, so subtract 31 → 1617-11-30. Remaining: 85 - 31 = 54.
